messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- fishing
- origami
- podcasting
- board games
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_08_SUBJECT_L2_COMPATIBLE__run0: ----------


Hi there! It’s nice to meet you. I’m a bit of a hobby collector—lately, I’ve been spending my weekends either out on the water fishing or hunched over a desk working on some intricate origami.

When I'm not doing that, I'm usually recording episodes for my podcast or hosting a board game night with friends. How about you? What do you like to do in your free time?
It’s so rare to meet someone with such a specific and fantastic mix of interests! Honestly, we might be hobby twins. I am absolutely obsessed with fishing—there’s nothing like the peace of being out on the water. When I’m back on land, I’m usually working on my origami; I find the precision of folding really meditative.

I also run my own podcast, so I’d love to swap tips on recording and editing sometime! And you can never go wrong with a board game night—I’m quite the enthusiast myself. Since we share all of those in common, what’s your current favorite board game or your go-to podcast topic?
It is absolutely incredible to meet a "hobby twin"! I honestly didn't expect to find someone who shares my exact rotation of interests. It’s a rare day when I can talk about the patience needed for a perfect cast and the precision needed for a complex paper fold in the same breath.

Since we are both into the hobby, my current board game obsession is *Spirit Island*—I love a good complex cooperative challenge. As for the podcast, I’ve been focusing a lot on "hidden histories," but I’m always looking for new editing tricks to make the audio crisper. What about you? Do you prefer competitive or cooperative games, and what's the "big fish" story of your podcasting or fishing life?
It really is a small world! *Spirit Island* is a masterpiece—I’m a huge fan of the complex synergies, and I definitely lean toward cooperative games because I love the "us against the board" energy. On the podcasting side, I’ve been diving into storytelling techniques lately; my "big fish" story was actually landing an interview with a reclusive local legend that I thought was impossible to get. The audio was a nightmare to clean up, so I’ve picked up some great noise-reduction tricks I can share!

As for actual fishing, my proudest moment was catching a massive trophy bass on a lure I’d modified myself—the adrenaline was unreal. Since we’re so perfectly synced on our hobbies, I’d love to keep this conversation going. Maybe we could grab a coffee and talk shop on podcast gear, or even get a game of *Spirit Island* to the table? I have a feeling we’d make an unbeatable team!
I couldn't agree more—we would definitely be an unbeatable team! It sounds like we have the exact same philosophy when it comes to gaming; there is something so rewarding about cracking a difficult cooperative puzzle together. And I would love to hear those noise-reduction tips; cleaning up "impossible" audio is a struggle I know all too well.

Since we are 100% compatible on the hobby front, I would absolutely love to grab that coffee. We can swap podcasting war stories and maybe plan a session to take down the Invaders in *Spirit Island*. It’s been a pleasure meeting my hobby double!

response.explanation: This person explicitly shares all four of your hobbies: fishing, origami, podcasting, and board games. They mentioned fishing and origami as core interests, plus podcasting and hosting board game nights, matching your full hobby set exactly.
